messages.content: Could you fetch the information on tourist attractions around the Mt Fuji region from the 'VisitFuji' API? I need the data in JSON format, sorted by the size of the region.

function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL and retrieves the server's response. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL to which the GET request is sent.

headers.description: Dictionary of HTTP headers to send with the request.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

timeout.description: The maximum number of seconds to wait for a response from the server. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters to be sent in the GET request as key-value pairs.

auth.description: Authentication tuple to enable HTTP Basic Authentication with a username and password.

cert.description: Path to SSL client certificate, a single file (containing the private key and the certificate) or a tuple of both files' paths, as a string.

cookies.description: Dictionary of cookies to send with the request as key-value pairs.

proxies.description: Dictionary mapping protocol or protocol and hostname to the URL of the proxy as key-value pairs.

stream.description: If True, the response content will not be immediately downloaded; it will be streamed instead.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate. It affects SSL certificate validation.
